classification_definition.authors_a_payload_and_has_no_restore_in_: a write of a payload this source builds, and no write of the face's own bytes anywhere in the source
classification_definition.authors_a_payload_and_puts_the_original_: a write of a payload this source builds, and a later write of the face's own saved bytes
classification_definition.never_writes_the_published_basename: no write site in this source names the published basename
classification_definition.writes_only_a_saved_backup_of_the_face: the source only ever puts the face's own saved bytes back

method_limits: the population is E492's 51 names minus E493's two; a harness E492 never found is outside this study
authorship is decided from the source's own AST, so a payload built inside a helper this build does not follow is published as unclassifiable rather than as safe
a name is traced through at most two hops, so a payload handed through three names reads as unclassifiable
the producer arm answers shape and verdict, not bytes: a copy that is a stale vintage of its own producer still matches here
the write forms recognised are handle writes, json.dump, and the copy/move families; a write performed by a subprocess or a library call inside another file is not seen

payload_definition.a_payload_the_source_constructs: the argument is a serialisation, a literal, a string build, or a name bound to one
payload_definition.a_payload_this_build_cannot_classify: the argument could not be traced within two name hops
payload_definition.a_saved_backup_of_the_same_face: the argument traces to a read of the same published file (or a copy of it)
payload_definition.bytes_copied_from_another_path: a copy/move whose source is a different basename

population_note: E492's multi-composed names minus the names E493 already answered; both lists are read from the newest parent faces, and the excluded names are published rather than dropped
title: Do the other 49 multi-composed latest faces carry a composer that authors a payload of its own, and how many of those writes have no restore in the same source?
